changelog:
- Initial release of docx-writer skill for generating standard academic Word documents.
- Supports native footnote creation via bayoo-docx, avoiding manual OOXML modification.
- Provides validated template and formatting functions for strict academic layout compliance.
- Offers ready-to-use, pre-validated scripts for document generation—users only need to fill in content and footnote details.
- Includes comprehensive documentation on styling, layout rules, and known issues/workarounds for footnotes and tables.
summary: Generate academic-standard Word documents with correctly formatted native footnotes, styled text, tables, and images using bayoo-docx and lxml.
